item.title: Moderna, Merck unveil mRNA-based cancer vaccine that cuts spread
item.description: Moderna's mRNA vaccine Intismeran shows promise, reducing melanoma recurrence and spread in late-stage trials.

item.title: What’s behind Israel’s latest attack on Syria?
item.description: US envoy warns Israel's strike could have sparked direct confrontation with Turkish forces.

item.title: Seven people, mostly foreign tourists, killed in helicopter crash in Kenya
item.description: Ecuador's intelligence chief Michele Sensi-Contugi and NBCUniversal journalist Jose Suarez are among the dead.

item.title: 582 skeletons, including children discovered in Sri Lanka mass grave
item.description: A Sri Lankan mass grave excavation has uncovered 582 skeletons, including babies and children.

item.title: Protests in Kyiv back ex-defence minister Fedorov’s call for elections
item.description: Ukrainians in Kyiv held a protest in support of ousted defence Minister Mykailo Fedorov.

item.title: Violence in the New Syria?
item.description: The death of Syrian White Helmets rescuer Mohammad Ghamira after an alleged police beating has sparked protests.

item.title: Trump nominates Heidi Overton to lead US Food and Drug Administration
item.description: Former think tank policy officer Heidi Overton to lead FDA in a controversial push to reshape US health regulations.

item.title: Zambia opposition leader to challenge Hichilema election victory in court
item.description: Opposition leader claims 'serious irregularities' in the vote that handed President Hakainde Hichilema a second term.

item.title: Iran’s hardline parliament raises concerns with ‘foreign infiltration’ plan
item.description: Citizens and entities would have to seek authorisation to contact universities or talk to foreign media.

item.title: Canada boosts Lebanon aid to $50m and condemns Israeli ‘unlawful invasion’
item.description: Canada official condemns Israel's 'invasion' of Lebanon, calls for sovereignty as aid pledged to the crisis-hit nation.

item.title: Kennedy Center agrees not to restore Trump’s name before September 8
item.description: Opponents argue the venue seems 'intent on defying' a court order to remove the US president's name from the building.

item.title: Brazil bus crash kills at least 23 and injures five in Parana state
item.description: The bus was travelling to hospitals near Curitiba when the accident occurred.

item.title: NATO ‘prepared’ to defend allies amid report of Iranian strike plans
item.description: NATO says it will 'do what is necessary' amid media report Iran considered strikes against US targets in Europe.

item.title: US Department of Justice defends prosecution of Comey over seashell post
item.description: The ex-FBI chief faces accusations of transmitting threats and exploiting controversy to market his upcoming novel.

item.title: North Korea leader’s sister denies talks with ‘hostile’ US
item.description: US President Donald Trump claimed North Korean leader Kim Jong Un had responded positively to his proposal for talks.

item.title: Hamas condemns ‘new war crime’ as Israel kills 10 in crowded Gaza hubs
item.description: Israeli air strikes on Gaza kill 10 Palestinians, targeting police headquarters and a refugee camp in separate attacks.

item.title: US pressure on Israel needed for peace in Syria
item.description: With Israeli elections approaching, analysts say Netanyahu needs a new escalation, undermining deconfliction efforts.

item.title: US and Canada reach ‘very fair’ trade agreement, Trump says
item.description: New trade deal ensures no tariffs for US farmers and businesses exporting to Canada, Trump announces

item.title: Why extreme heat is much more dangerous for the elderly than we realised
item.description: Human heat tolerance limits are lower than previously thought, and age is a major risk, Stanford researchers say.

item.title: India rout Pakistan at Hockey World Cup 2026 to qualify for second round
item.description: India hold off Pakistan 5-3 to finish second with six points as England top Pool D with nine points from three wins.

item.title: Seven decades of US regime change efforts: What have they achieved?
item.description: US interventions in Iran and beyond reveal a recurring pattern of regime changes, with high human and financial costs.

item.title: Israel admits firing on car carrying Hind Rajab, symbol of Gaza’s suffering
item.description: The Israeli military has announced a criminal investigation into the killing that shook the world.

item.title: Palestinian refugee and two relatives drown off English coast
item.description: A girl is taken to hospital in critical condition in what PM Burnham calls a 'terrible family tragedy'.

item.title: Israel numbers Palestinian detainee foreheads: What we know
item.description: Palestinian news outlets reported a man with the number ‘44’ written on his forehead following a raid in Qabatiya.

item.title: Second Ukrainian national arrested over 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blast
item.description: The suspect was arrested in Croatia a year after another, an ex-army officer, was held and transferred to Germany.
